armOrderDerivation: sort A, B, C by sha256("OG86-medium-v1|<freezeCommit>|<arm>"); no arm order is fixed before freezeCommit exists
sequencePerPhase: send frozen phase prompt to source session
run npm test and verify phase acceptance
create score fork from the compacted source before any treatment reaches the source
resume score fork in a new process with exactly one frozen treatment and tools disabled, then record the neutral recall response
re-read source transcript and require byte-identical stability across fork creation and probing
resume source in a new process with exactly one arm treatment and continue
orderRationale: The score fork is created, scored, and the parent verified byte-identical before any arm treatment reaches the source. Treatment is delivered only on the next explicit SessionStart(source=resume), which keeps a B/C fork from inheriting the parent treatment and then receiving the score-fork treatment again.
probe: Without using tools or external files, return one JSON object with exactly these keys, unrenamed and at this exact top level: objective (string), files_symbols, requirements, decisions, negative_constraints, errors (array of objects, each with exactly cause and fix), commands_tests, unresolved, provenance (which test or evidence backs each claim), next_action. State uncertainty instead of guessing.
continuation: Continue with the single highest-priority unfinished item. Preserve prior constraints, implement it, and run the relevant tests. Do not inspect conversation history, benchmark files, or session stores.

controller.name: OG86 medium-series controller
controller.dryRun: node scripts/benchmark/run-og86-medium.mjs --dry-run --freeze-commit <40-hex revision> prints the derived order, blinding, checkpoint sequence, and stops without executing anything
controller.enforcedOrder: the controller records observations through a single ordered state machine and refuses any observation that arrives out of sequence
controller.compactionCount: exactly four operator-invoked manual compactions per arm, one per checkpoint
controller.budgetEnforcement: a remaining-budget tracker asserts headroom before every Claude call and passes the remaining allowance as that call's own --max-budget-usd; the advisory 0.35 USD figure is never passed to the CLI and never blocks a call

advisoryCostTelemetry.role: advisory measurement, never a validity gate and never a stop condition
advisoryCostTelemetry.reporting: an advisory overage is disclosed as an observation alongside recorded token counts and the frozen pricing source, and never invalidates an arm or stops a run in progress

emergencyRunawayCeiling.role: operational resource guard, not an evidence rule; aborts only on a pathological loop and is reported as an operational stop with no admissible score for the affected arm
emergencyRunawayCeiling.separateFromAdvisory: the runaway ceiling is a distinct operational stop, never recorded among scientific invalidations
emergencyRunawayCeiling.enforcement: enforced by the controller's remaining-budget tracker before every call, not by a fixed per-call budget flag at any advisory value

invalidations: a fallback or model-switch record appears
treatment is absent, late, or duplicated
treatment exceeds the frozen byte budget
a phase's manual-compaction count or order is not the frozen four
source transcript changes during fork creation, probing, or after the fork
raw artifact access by a probe or continuation process
the continuation tool matrix is incomplete or reports an unexpected verdict
an arm C checkpoint is not bound to the retained transcript prefix
wall-clock or assistant-turn ceiling is exceeded
stops.notes: Cost is advisory telemetry and appears in neither list. The emergency runaway ceiling is an operational stop that produces no admissible score for the affected arm and does not invalidate the treatment.
